titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Three Angels and Solomon’s Thanksgiving (ch. 68, part 2 of 2)
part: ch. 68, part 2 of 2 — The Three Angels and Solomon’s Thanksgiving
about: The angel completes the account of the pearl: Zion went with the firstborn David (Menelik) to Ethiopia, while the pearl was carried into Jeroboam’s line, from which the saviour will be born; Gabriel, Michael and Uriel are assigned as guardians of Solomon’s three sons, and the tree of the cross is foretold. Solomon bows down, thanks God, and says he no longer fears death, Sheol or scattering, because his soul will be with David, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob when the saviour brings them out.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ትጸወር ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ በተባዕት ፡ እለ ፡ ትከውኑ ፡ ጻድቃነ ፡ ወአንስትሂ ፡ እለ ፡ ጾራ ፡ ምጽዋረ ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ ኢይትሀጐላ ፡ እስመ ፡ ንጹሓተ ፡ ይከውና ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ወንጽሕት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወባቲ ፡ ትትቄደሱ ፡ ወትነጽሑ ፤
sentences.l: For the-pearl is-carried (?) in-males who you-are righteous, and-women-also who carried burden-of pearl not-will-be-lost-they, for pure they-will-be in-that pearl, for holy and-pure she, and-by-her you-are-sanctified and-you-are-cleansed;
sentences.i: For the pearl is carried (?) by the men among you who are righteous; and the women who carried the burden of the pearl will not be lost, for they will be made pure in her, the pearl, since she is holy and pure, and by her you are sanctified and cleansed;
sentences.n: The one image of the whole chapter is ባሕርይ ‘the pearl’, the line of descent that carries the saviour; ch. 68 part 1 ends with the promise that none of its carriers is lost, and this unit explains why. ትጸወር is read as a passive ‘is carried’, the verb ጾረ ‘carry’ with ባሕርይ as its subject and በተባዕት ‘in/by males’ as the carriers (?); it could also be an active form with the pearl as object, ‘(you) carry the pearl’, and the vowel-less fidäl does not settle it (?). ትከውኑ is 2mp (‘you … are’), so the angel is addressing Solomon’s line directly. ወአንስትሂ = ወ- + አንስት ‘women’ + -ሂ ‘also’. ጾራ is the 3fp perfect (feminine plural, ending -ኣ) ‘they (f.) carried’; ምጽዋረ is the construct of ምጽዋር, here ‘the carrying, the burden’ (?). ኢይትሀጐላ is the 3fp imperfect of the tä-stem of ሀጐለ ‘perish’, ‘they will not be lost’. ንጹሓተ is the plural of ንጹሕ ‘pure’ in the accusative (predicate); ይከውና is 3fp imperfect of ኮነ. በይእቲ ባሕርይ = በ- ‘in’ + ይእቲ ‘she’ + ባሕርይ in apposition, ‘in her, the pearl’ (the ይእቲ resumes the noun, as in ch. 68 part 1). ወባቲ = ወ- + በ- + -ቲ ‘her’, ‘and by her’; ትትቄደሱ and ወትነጽሑ are 2mp imperfects of tä-stems, ‘you are sanctified, you are cleansed’ (ቀደሰ ‘be holy’, ነጽሐ ‘be clean’).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ በእንቲአሃ ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ፈጠሮ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ዓለም ።
sentences.l: for on-account-of-her and-on-account-of Zion he-created-it all-of world.
sentences.i: for it was for her sake, and for Zion’s, that he created the whole world.
sentences.n: በእንቲአሃ = በእንተ ‘on account of’ with the 3fs suffix -ሃ (stem በእንቲአ-), ‘for her sake’; ወበእንተ ጽዮን ‘and for Zion’. ፈጠሮ = ፈጠረ ‘created’ + -ኦ ‘it’, with ለኵሉ ዓለም ‘all the world’ repeating the object (ለ- marks the object here). Zion and the pearl are named together as the two reasons for creation: Zion is the Ark (ታቦት), and the pearl is the line of the saviour.

sentences.t: ጽዮንሰ ፡ ነበረት ፡ ኀበ ፡ በኵርከ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ መድኀኒቶሙ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወባሕርይኒ ፡ ተጸውረት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከርሠ ፡ አዮር ፡ በዓም ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ዓለም ፤
sentences.l: Zion-indeed stayed with your-firstborn and-she-will-be their-salvation for-people-of Ethiopia until for-eternity, and-the-pearl-also was-carried into womb-of Ayor-baʿam your-son and-she-will-be salvation for-all-of world;
sentences.i: As for Zion, she stayed with your firstborn and will be the salvation of the people of Ethiopia for ever; and the pearl was carried into the womb of Jeroboam, your son, and will be salvation for the whole world;
sentences.n: ጽዮንሰ = ጽዮን + the emphatic/contrastive -ሰ: ‘as for Zion’, set against the pearl, ‘and the pearl, for her part’ (ባሕርይኒ, with -ኒ ‘also’). The contrast is the point of the chapter: Zion goes to Menelik, the firstborn, to Ethiopia, while the pearl goes to another son. ወትከውን is 3fs ‘she will be’, agreeing with Zion. ለሕዝበ ኢትዮጵያ = ለ- ‘for’ + ሕዝበ ‘people of’ (construct) + ኢትዮጵያ. ለዓለም after እስከ ‘until’ is the idiom ‘for ever’. ተጸውረት is the passive 3fs perfect of ጾረ ‘carry’, ‘she was carried’ (a perfect for what is already decided). አዮር ፡ በዓም is printed as two words by a wordspace; it is the name ኢዮርብዓም ‘Jeroboam’ written in a variant form, which I read as one name (?); the next units spell it ኢዮርብዓም. Bezold’s text gives Jeroboam for Solomon’s son where 1 Kings 12 has Rehoboam; I keep the name as written.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አመ ፡ በጽሐ ፡ ዕድሜሁ ፡ ትትወለድ ፡ እምዘርእከ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ እስመ ፡ ንጽሕት ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ምስብዒተ ፡ እምነ ፡ ፀሐይ ፤
sentences.l: for when reached his-age, she-will-be-born from-your-seed she the-pearl, for pure exceedingly sevenfold (?) than sun;
sentences.i: for when her appointed time arrives, she will be born of your seed, that pearl, for she is far purer, seven times over (?), than the sun;
sentences.n: እስመ introduces the reason for the pearl’s reaching the world through Jeroboam’s line. በጽሐ is the 3ms perfect ‘reached’ and ዕድሜሁ ‘his age, his time’ is its subject; the -ሁ ‘his’ is masculine although ባሕርይ is treated as feminine (ይእቲ, ንጽሕት), so the owner of the ‘age’ is not certain: perhaps the saviour’s, perhaps a loose reference to the pearl (?). ትትወለድ is 3fs imperfect of the tä-stem of ወለደ, ‘she will be born’. ምስብዒተ is the crux of this unit: the form looks like a noun or adverb from ሰብዐ ‘seven’ (‘sevenfold’, accusative), which would read ‘seven times (purer) than the sun’ and fits Isaiah 30:26 (‘the light of the sun will be sevenfold’); I take it so (?) but cannot confirm the word in the lexicon. እምነ ፀሐይ = እምነ ‘than’ (comparative እም- before a noun) + ፀሐይ ‘sun’; ፈድፋደ ‘exceedingly’.

sentences.t: ወይመጽእ ፡ መድኅን ፡ እመንበረ ፡ መለኮቱ ፡ ወየኀድር ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ወይለብስ ፡ ሥጋሃ ፤
sentences.l: and-will-come saviour from-throne-of his-divinity and-will-dwell upon-her and-will-put-on her-flesh;
sentences.i: and a saviour will come from the throne of his divinity, and will dwell upon her, and will put on her flesh;
sentences.n: The incarnation, put in the pearl’s language. እመንበረ = እም- ‘from’ + መንበረ ‘throne of’ (construct of መንበር); መለኮቱ is መለኮት ‘divinity, godhead’ + -ሁ ‘his’, so ‘the throne of his divinity’, a construct chain with a suffix at the end. ይመጽእ and ወየኀድር are 3ms imperfects (መጽአ ‘come’, ኀደረ ‘dwell’); ላዕሌሃ ‘upon her’ recalls the Annunciation (Luke 1:35, ‘the power of the Most High will overshadow you’), though the Geʿez verb is ‘dwell’. ይለብስ ‘he puts on’ (ለብሰ ‘put on, be clothed’), ሥጋሃ ‘her flesh’ (the flesh is Mary’s, as the pearl’s end-point).

sentences.t: ወአሜሃኒ ፡ ለሊከ ፡ ትዜንዋ ፡ ይቤለኒ ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ ወእግዚእከ ፡ አነ ፡ ገብርኤል ፡ መልአክ ፡ ዐቃቢክሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ትጸውር ፡ ዋ ፡ ለባሕርይ ፡ እምከርሠ ፡ አዳም ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ከርሠ ፡ ሐና ፡ ከመ ፡ እክላእክሙ ፡ እምግብርናት ፡ ወርኵስ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተኀድር ፡ ባሕርይ ፤
sentences.l: And-now-also yourself you-will-tell-of-her; he-said-to-me my-lord and-your-lord: I Gabriel angel your-guardian, of-those you-carry-her, of-pearl, from-womb-of Adam and-until womb-of Hannah, that I-may-keep-you from-servitudes and-uncleanness where dwells pearl;
sentences.i: And now, you yourself will tell of her; so my lord and your lord has said to me. I am Gabriel, the angel, the guardian of you who carry her, the pearl, from the womb of Adam to the womb of Hannah, to keep you from servitude and uncleanness wherever the pearl dwells;
sentences.n: The speaker is an angel and he now names himself as Gabriel (the same speaker as ‘the angel’ of ch. 67–68 part 1, I take it (?)). The sentence is compressed and the order of speech is uncertain (?): I read ወአሜሃኒ ለሊከ ትዜንዋ as ‘and now, you yourself will tell of her’ (ትዜንዋ = 2ms imperfect of ዜነወ ‘tell, announce’ + -ዋ ‘her’), and ይቤለኒ እግዚእየ ወእግዚእከ as the angel’s aside, ‘my lord and your lord told me’, the Lord being the one who sends him. ወአሜሃኒ = ወ- + አሜሃ ‘now’ + -ኒ ‘also’. ለእለ ትጸውር ፡ ዋ is the crux: ትጸውር and ዋ are divided by a wordspace; I read them as one word ትጸውርዋ, the 2mp imperfect ትጸውሩ ‘you carry’ + -ዋ ‘her’ (the -ሩ + -ዋ coalesces to -ርዋ, as ጾርክምዋ in part 1), with ለባሕርይ repeating the object: ‘you who carry her, the pearl’. ዐቃቢክሙ = ዐቃቢ ‘guardian’ + -ክሙ ‘your’ (plural). Gabriel with Michael and Uriel are the three guardian angels of the three sons (see the next units). እምከርሠ … ወእስከ ከርሠ ‘from the womb of … to the womb of’: ከርሠ is the construct of ከርሥ ‘womb’. ሐና is Hannah, mother of Joachim, the last carrier in part 1. ከመ እክላእክሙ = ከመ + 1cs subjunctive of አክልአ ‘keep back, protect’ + -ክሙ ‘you’. እምግብርናት ‘from servitudes’ (plural of ግብርና) (?). ኀበ ተኀድር ባሕርይ: ኀበ ‘where’ + 3fs imperfect ‘she dwells’.

sentences.t: ወሚካኤልኒ ፡ ተአዘዘ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ከመ ፡ ይመግባ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሖረት ፤
sentences.l: And-Michael-also was-commanded concerning Zion that he-may-feed-her in-all where she-went;
sentences.i: And Michael, too, was commanded concerning Zion, to feed her in every place she went;
sentences.n: ወሚካኤልኒ = ወ- + ሚካኤል ‘Michael’ + -ኒ ‘also’. Michael looks after Zion, the Ark, which has gone to Ethiopia with Menelik (David, the firstborn; see unit 11). ተአዘዘ is the 3ms perfect passive of አዘዘ ‘command’; ኀበ ጽዮን ‘concerning Zion, toward Zion’ (?). ይመግባ = ከመ + 3ms subjunctive of መገበ ‘feed, nourish’ + -ኣ ‘her’. ኀበ ሖረት = ‘where she went’ (ሖረ ‘go’, 3fs perfect); I render the past as a habitual ‘went’, ‘every place she goes’ would be as good.

sentences.t: ወኡርያልኒ ፡ ይሜግብ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ ሳቤቅ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትከውን ፡ መስቀሎ ፡ ለመድኅን ።
sentences.l: And-Uriel-also he-tends (?) tree-of Sabek which will-be his-cross for-saviour.
sentences.i: And Uriel will tend the tree of Sabek, which will become the cross of the saviour.
sentences.n: ዕፀ ሳቤቅ ‘tree of Sabek’: ዕፀ is the construct of ዕፅ ‘tree, wood’. ሳቤቅ is the word of Genesis 22:13 in the Greek-based Geʿez Bible (LXX σαβεκ, Hebrew sĕbak ‘thicket’), the thicket in which Abraham’s ram was caught; the tree there is the type of the cross, so here ‘the tree of Sabek’ is the wood that will become the cross. I take it so (?). ይሜግብ is irregular: the stem looks like መገበ ‘feed’ but the vowel after ሜ is unusual; I read it as ‘he tends, feeds’ (nourishes the tree until the time) (?). እንተ ትከውን = ‘which will be’ (fem. relative + 3fs imperfect). መስቀሎ ለመድኅን ‘his cross, the saviour’s’: a suffix first, then ለ- + the owner. Uriel is the third of the angels.

sentences.t: ወአመ ፡ ሰቀልዎ ፡ በቅንአቶሙ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ ሀለዎሙ ፡ ይድብይዎ ፡ ለመስቀሉ ፡ እምብዝኀ ፡ ተኣምራት ፡ ዘይከውን ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ወየኀፍሩ ፡ ርኢዮሙ ፡ መንክራቲሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-when they-crucify-him in-their-envy, your-people, it-is-for-them they-may-hide-him (?), the-cross-his, from-abundance-of wonders which will-be through-it; and-they-will-be-ashamed seeing-them his-marvels;
sentences.i: And when they crucify him in their envy, your people, they will be set to hide his cross (?), because of the abundance of wonders that will come through it, and they will be ashamed when they see his marvels;
sentences.n: ወአመ ሰቀልዎ = ወ- + አመ ‘when’ + 3mp perfect of ሰቀለ ‘crucify’ + -ኦ ‘him’; በቅንአቶሙ ‘in their jealousy, envy’ (ቅንአት + -ሆሙ). ሕዝብከ is ‘your people’, Israel, in apposition to the subject. ሀለዎሙ ይድብይዎ is the crux: ሀለዎሙ is ሀሎ ‘be’ + -ሆሙ ‘to them’, ‘it is for them, they are to’, followed by a subjunctive; ይድብይዎ is the subjunctive of a verb I read as ‘hide, bury’ + -ኦ ‘it’, with ለመስቀሉ repeating the object, ‘to bury/hide the cross’ (?). I take it from context: the cross is hidden and later taken up (next unit), the story of the finding of the cross. ተአምራት ‘wonders, signs’; ዘይከውን ቦቱ ‘which will be through it’. ወየኀፍሩ ‘and they will be ashamed’ (ኀፈረ, 3mp imperfect, indicative); ርኢዮሙ ‘their seeing’ (verbal noun of ርእየ ‘see’ + -ሆሙ), with መንክራቲሁ ‘his marvels’ as the object.

sentences.t: ወበደኃሪ ፡ ይነሥኦ ፡ ለዕፀ ፡ መስቀል ፡ ዘርአ ፡ አድራሚስ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ፫ ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ ዘተፈነወ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
sentences.l: And-in-latter he-will-take-it, the-tree-of cross, seed-of Adramis your-son, three (?), saviour who-was-sent upon earth.
sentences.i: And in the end the seed of Adramis, your third son (?), will take up the wood of the cross of the saviour who was sent upon the earth.
sentences.n: ወበደኃሪ = ወ- + በ- + ደኃሪ ‘the last, the end’, ‘and in the end, afterwards’. ይነሥኦ ለዕፀ መስቀል = 3ms imperfect of ነሥአ ‘take, take up’ + -ኦ ‘it’, with ለዕፀ መስቀል ‘the tree of the cross’ repeating the object (ዕፀ construct, መስቀል ‘cross’). ዘርአ አድራሚስ ‘seed of Adramis’: ዘርአ is the construct, so the descendants of Adramis, not Adramis himself, take the cross; Ethiopian tradition makes the cross come to Ethiopia in this way. አድራሚስ is the same name as አድራሚ in unit 13 (the youngest son); the final -ስ is probably a Greek-style ending or a scribal addition (?). The numeral ፫ stands after ወልድከ and is not a normal part of the sentence: I read it as ‘third’, because the sons are three (David, Jeroboam, Adrami; units 11–13) (?); the alternative is a stray numeral in the transmission. መድኀኒተ is the accusative ‘saviour’; ዘተፈነወ = ዘ- ‘who’ + tä-stem perfect of ፈነወ ‘send’, ‘who was sent’; ዲበ ምድር ‘upon the earth’.

sentences.t: ሚካኤል ፡ መልአክ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ምስለ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወልድከ ፡ በኵርከ ፡ ዘነሥአ ፡ መንበረ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡከ ፤
sentences.l: Michael angel with Zion, with David your-son, your-firstborn, who-took throne-of David your-father;
sentences.i: The angel Michael is with Zion, together with David, your firstborn son, who took the throne of David your father;
sentences.n: There is no verb: ‘(is) with’ is understood, and the three angels are assigned to the three sons in turn. ኀበ ጽዮን ‘with Zion, at Zion’ (ኀበ ‘to, with, at’). ምስለ ዳዊት ወልድከ በኵርከ: ‘David’ here is the young prince Menelik, styled David (ch. 66–67), who takes Zion to Ethiopia, and he is the ‘firstborn’. ዘነሥአ ‘who took’ is the perfect of ነሥአ; ‘who has taken’ or ‘who will take’ is equally possible, because the angel is speaking of what is already decided. መንበረ ዳዊት አቡከ ‘throne of David your father’: a construct chain, መንበረ ‘throne of’ with ዳዊት, and አቡከ = አብ ‘father’ + -ከ ‘your’ (a possessive suffix after the owner, in apposition).

sentences.t: ወአነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ባሕርይ ፡ ንጽሕት ፡ ለዘ ፡ ይነግሥ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኢዮርብዓም ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ማእከላዊ ፤
sentences.l: and-I with pearl pure, for-him-who he-reigns until for-eternity, with Jeroboam your-son, the-middle;
sentences.i: and I am with the pure pearl, for him who will reign for ever, with Jeroboam, your middle son;
sentences.n: ወአነ ኀበ ባሕርይ = ‘and I, with the pearl’: the speaker is Gabriel (unit 6), so Gabriel guards the pearl and Jeroboam, the middle son. ንጽሕት is the fem. ‘pure’ in agreement with ባሕርይ (grammatically feminine in this text). ለዘ ፡ ይነግሥ is ዘ- ‘he who’ + ይነግሥ ‘he reigns’ (3ms imperfect of ነገሠ), spaced by a wordspace in the edition; ለ- ‘for’; the one who reigns for ever is the saviour (compare Luke 1:33, ‘he will reign over the house of Jacob for ever’). ማእከላዊ ‘the middle one’ (a noun in -ዊ ‘of the middle’, from ማእከል ‘middle’). The name ኢዮርብዓም is Bezold’s name for Solomon’s son; see the note at unit 3.

sentences.t: ወኡርኤል ፡ መልአክ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አድራሚ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ዘይንእስ ።
sentences.l: and-Uriel angel with Adrami your-son, who-is-young.
sentences.i: and the angel Uriel is with Adrami, your son, the youngest.
sentences.n: ወኡርኤል = ወ- ‘and’ + ኡርኤል ‘Uriel’ (spelled ኡርያል in unit 8). ዘይንእስ = ዘ- ‘who’ + ይንእስ ‘is small, young’ (3ms imperfect of ንእሰ), ‘the younger one’, so ‘the youngest’ with three sons. አድራሚ is unexplained, a name (compare አድራሚስ in unit 10), or a corrupt word; I keep ‘Adrami’ (?).

sentences.t: ዘንተ ፡ ነገርኩከ ፡ ወኢታሕዝን ፡ ልበከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ መድኀኒትከ ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ ደቂቅከ ፨
sentences.l: This I-told-you and-do-not-grieve your-heart concerning your-salvation and-concerning salvation-of your-sons ፨
sentences.i: I have told you this; do not let your heart grieve, about your salvation and about the salvation of your sons.
sentences.n: ዘንተ ‘this’ (accusative of ዝንቱ), ነገርኩከ = 1cs perfect of ነገረ ‘say, tell’ + -ከ ‘you’. ኢታሕዝን is the 2ms jussive of አሕዘነ ‘make sad, grieve’, with ልበከ ‘your heart’ as its object, ‘do not make your heart sad’. መድኀኒትከ ‘your salvation’ and ወበእንተ መድኀኒተ ደቂቅከ ‘and concerning the salvation of your sons’ (መድኀኒተ is the construct before ደቂቅ ‘sons’; ደቂቅከ = ደቂቅ + -ከ). The ፨ closes the angel’s speech and the vision.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ሰምዐ ፡ ተኀየለ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ምስካቡ ፡ ወሰገደ ፡ ለመልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ኣአኵቶ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለእግዚእየ ፡ ወለእ ፡ ግዚእከ ፡ ኦብርሃናዊ ፡ መንፈሳዊ ፡ ዘአስማዕከኒ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘያስተፈሥሐኒ ፡ ዘኢይሜቊሳ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ በእንተ ፡ አበሳየ ፡ እምርስተ ፡ አበውየ ፡ ዘተወክፈ ፡ ንስሓየ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ምንዳቤየ ፡ ዘነጸረ ፡ አንብዕየ ፡ ወሰምዐ ፡ ገዓርየ ፡ ዘርእየ ፡ ምንዳቤየ ፡ ወኢኀደገኒ ፡ ትኩዝየ ፡ እሞት ፡ አላ ፡ አስተፈሥሐኒ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ትፃእ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ እምሥጋየ ፤
sentences.l: And-this when he-heard he-was-strengthened in-his-bed and-he-bowed-down to-angel-of God and-said: I-thank God, my-lord, and-your-lord, O luminous spiritual-one, who made-me-hear word who gladdens-me, who not he-cut-off her (?), my-soul, on-account-of my-sin, from-inheritance-of my-fathers; who received my-repentance after my-distress, who regarded my-tears and-heard my-wailing, who saw my-distress and-did-not-leave-me, my-grief, I-die, but gladdened-me before goes-out my-soul from-my-body;
sentences.i: And when he heard this, he took strength on his bed and bowed down to the angel of God, and said: “I thank God, my lord and your lord; and you, O angel of light, spiritual one, who made me hear a word that gladdens me, a word that does not cut off my soul (?), for my sin, from the inheritance of my fathers; who received my repentance after my distress, who saw my tears and heard my wailing, who saw my distress and did not leave me to die in my grief, but gladdened me before my soul goes out from my body;
sentences.n: This is Solomon’s thanksgiving, the start of his psalm-like reply, and the longest unit of the part: it has no ፤ at which to cut. ወዘንተ ሶበ ሰምዐ ‘and when he heard this’; ተኀየለ is the 3ms perfect of the tä-stem of ኀየለ ‘be strong’, ‘he took strength, he was strengthened’; ምስካቡ ‘his bed’. ወሰገደ ለመልአከ እግዚኣብሔር ‘and bowed to the angel of God’ (ሰገደ + ለ-, then መልአከ ‘angel of’, construct). ኣአኵቶ is written ኣ-, the 1cs imperfect of አኰተ ‘give thanks’ + -ኦ ‘him’, with ለእግዚኣብሔር repeating the object. ወለእ ፡ ግዚእከ is one word split by a wordspace, ወለእግዚእከ ‘and to your lord’; it is a second object of the thanks, ‘to my lord and to your lord’, i.e. God (Solomon calls him the lord of both himself and the angel). ኦብርሃናዊ መንፈሳዊ: ኦ ‘O’ + ብርሃናዊ ‘of light, luminous’ + መንፈሳዊ ‘spiritual’, addressed to the angel (the phrase can, less likely, address God (?)). ዘአስማዕከኒ = ዘ- ‘who’ + 2ms perfect of the causative of ሰምዐ ‘hear’, ‘you made me hear’ + -ኒ ‘me’; the relative clauses that follow (ዘያስተፈሥሐኒ ‘which gladdens me’) qualify ቃለ ‘a word’. ዘኢይሜቊሳ is uncertain (?): I read the verb as ‘cut off, deprive’ with the -ሳ for -ኣ ‘her’, resumed by ለነፍስየ ‘my soul’, and ‘from the inheritance of my fathers’ (እምርስተ አበውየ = እም- ‘from’ + ርስት ‘inheritance’, construct, + አበውየ ‘my fathers’), so that the word does not cut Solomon’s soul off from his fathers’ portion (?); this suits the end of the speech, where his soul is to be with David, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. The verbs ተወክፈ ‘received’, ነጸረ ‘looked at, regarded’, ሰምዐ ‘heard’, ርእየ ‘saw’ are 3ms perfects in relative clauses (ዘ-) describing God’s past favour; ንስሓየ ‘my repentance’, ምንዳቤየ ‘my distress’, አንብዕየ ‘my tears’, ገዓርየ ‘my wailing’, ትኩዝየ ‘my grief, anguish’ (?). ወኢኀደገኒ ትኩዝየ እሞት is read ‘did not leave me, in my grief, to die’ (እሞት = 1cs subjunctive of ሞተ, ‘that I die’) (?). ዘእንበለ ትፃእ ነፍስየ = ‘before (lit. ‘without’) my soul goes out’, ዘእንበለ + 3fs subjunctive.

sentences.t: እምይእዜሰ ፡ ኢያሐዝነኒ ፡ መዊት ፡ ወኣፈቅሮ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ እምይእዜሰ ፡ እሰርቦ ፡ ለጽዋዐ ፡ ሞት ፡ መሪር ፡ ከመ ፡ መዓር ፡ እምይእዜሰ ፡ ኣፈቅራ ፡ ለመቃብር ፡ ከመ ፡ ማኅደር ፡ ዘበ ፡ አፍራጽ ።
sentences.l: From-now-indeed not-grieves-me death, and-I-love-it like life; from-now-indeed I-will-drink-down the-cup-of death bitter like honey; from-now-indeed I-will-love-her, the-grave, like dwelling, of-in slabs (?).
sentences.i: From now on death does not grieve me, and I love it as I love life; from now on I will drink down the cup of death, bitter though it is, as if it were honey; from now on I will love the grave as a dwelling, one of slabs (?).
sentences.n: እምይእዜሰ = እም- ‘from’ + ይእዜ ‘now’ + the emphatic -ሰ, ‘from now on’, repeated three times as the speech builds. ኢያሐዝነኒ ‘does not grieve me’ (the same verb as ኢታሕዝን in unit 14, with -ኒ ‘me’). ወኣፈቅሮ ‘and I love him/it’ (ኣ- is the 1cs imperfect of አፍቀረ + -ኦ ‘it’, as ኣፈቅራ + -ኣ ‘her’ later). እሰርቦ = the 1cs imperfect of ሰርበ ‘swallow, drink down’ + -ኦ ‘it’ (?). ለጽዋዐ ሞት ‘the cup of death’ (construct, ለ- marking the object); መሪር ‘bitter’; the cup of death recalls the cup of Gethsemane and Psalm 116:13 only loosely. ከመ መዓር ‘like honey’. ለመቃብር ‘the grave’ (ለ- marking the object). ከመ ማኅደር ዘበ ፡ አፍራጽ is the crux: ዘ ፡ በ ፡ አፍራጽ is divided by wordspaces, so ዘበአፍራጽ ‘which is of/with slabs (?)’. I take አፍራጽ as a plural ‘slabs, pieces’ (the tomb as a dwelling built of slabs), but the word is not confirmed in the lexicon and the printed division may be wrong (?).

sentences.t: ወእመኒ ፡ ወረድኩ ፡ ወተወረውኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲኦል ፡ በእንተ ፡ አበሳየ ፡ ኢያሐዝነኒ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰማዕኩ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘያስተፈሥሐኒ ፤
sentences.l: And-if-also I-went-down and-I-was-cast into Sheol on-account-of my-sin, not-grieves-me, for I-heard word which gladdens-me;
sentences.i: And even if I go down and am thrown into Sheol because of my sin, it will not grieve me, since I have heard the word that gladdens me;
sentences.n: ወእመኒ = ወ- + እመ ‘if’ + -ኒ ‘also, even’, ‘and even if’; the following 1cs perfects (ወረድኩ ‘I went down’, ተወረውኩ ‘I was thrown’, the passive of ወረወ ‘throw’) are conditional, so English ‘if I go down’. ሲኦል ‘Sheol, the place of the dead’ (the part-1 theme of the saviour’s descent to Sheol to bring the fathers out). በእንተ አበሳየ ‘on account of my sin’ (አበሳ ‘sin’ + -የ ‘my’). እስመ ሰማዕኩ ‘for I heard’ (1cs perfect of ሰምዐ).

sentences.t: ወእመኒ ፡ ወረድኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መትሕተ ፡ ታሕቲት ፡ መዓምቅተ ፡ ሲኦል ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ አበሳየ ፡ ሚላዕሌየ ፤
sentences.l: And-if-also I-went-down into below-of lowest, depths-of Sheol, which on-account-of my-sin, what-upon-me (?);
sentences.i: And even if I go down into the lowest of the low, the depths of Sheol, which is mine for my sin — what is that to me (?);
sentences.n: The unit has a protasis only, and the main clause is carried over from unit 17 (‘it does not grieve me’). መትሕተ ታሕቲት ‘below the lowest’, the lowest depth: መትሕተ is the accusative of መትሕት ‘below’, ታሕቲት ‘lowest’ (fem.), and መዓምቅተ is the construct of መዓምቅት ‘depths’ (so ‘the depths of Sheol’, compare Psalm 88:6). ዘበእንተ አበሳየ ‘that (is) on account of my sin’. ሚላዕሌየ is the crux of this unit: I read ሚ ‘what?’ + ላዕሌየ ‘upon me’ (ላዕል ‘upon’ + -የ ‘me’, with the suffix stem ላዕሌ-), ‘what is it to me?’, a rhetorical question that closes the protasis (?). The alternative is a corrupt word in the edition (?). The line is the least secure of the speech.

sentences.t: ወእመኒ ፡ ጠሰየኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወዘረወኒ ፡ እስከ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ነፋሳት ፡ በእንተ ፡ አበሳየ ፡ ኢያሐዝነኒ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰማዕኩ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘያስተፈሥሐኒ ፡ ዘኢመቈሳ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እምርስተ ፡ አበዊየ ፤
sentences.l: And-if-also he-seized-me (?) into his-hand and-scattered-me until ends-of earth and-into winds on-account-of my-sin, not-grieves-me, for I-heard word which gladdens-me, which not he-cut-off her (?), my-soul, from-inheritance-of my-fathers;
sentences.i: And even if he seizes me in his hand (?) and scatters me to the ends of the earth and into the winds because of my sin, it will not grieve me, for I have heard the word that gladdens me, the word that does not cut off my soul from the inheritance of my fathers (?);
sentences.n: The third ‘even if’ clause: the thought is God himself carrying the sinner off. ጠሰየኒ is the 3ms perfect of ጠሰየ + -ኒ ‘me’; I read ‘seized, took hold of’ from the context (‘in his hand’) (?). ዘረወኒ = ዘረወ ‘scatter, cast’ + -ኒ ‘me’. እስከ አጽናፈ ምድር ‘to the ends of the earth’ (አጽናፈ is the construct of አጽናፍ ‘ends’). ውስተ ነፋሳት ‘into the winds’ (plural of ነፋስ). ዘኢመቈሳ ለነፍስየ እምርስተ አበዊየ repeats the clause of unit 15, here with the perfect ዘኢመቈሳ and አበዊየ (a variant plural of አብ ‘father’ with -የ); the verb and its sense are uncertain (?).

sentences.t: ወትከውን ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወይስሐቅ ፡ ወያዕቆብ ፡ አበዊየ ፡ ወይመጽእ ፡ መድኅን ፡ ወያወፅአነ ፡ እምሲኦል ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አበዊየ ፡ ወአዝማድየ ፡ ቀደምት ፡ ወደኀርት ፡ ወለደቂቅየኒ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ፫ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ኀያላን ፡ እለ ፡ የዐቅብዎሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-will-be my-soul with soul-of David my-father, and-with soul-of Abraham and-Isaac and-Jacob my-fathers; and-will-come saviour and-will-bring-us-out from-Sheol with all-of my-fathers and-my-kin, former and-later, and-for-my-sons-also upon earth, three angels mighty who they-guard-them;
sentences.i: And my soul will be with the soul of David my father, and with the souls of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, my fathers; and the saviour will come and bring us out of Sheol, with all my fathers and my kin, the earlier ones and the later ones; and for my sons too, on the earth, there are three mighty angels who guard them;
sentences.n: The hope of Solomon, his fathers’ company: ወትከውን ነፍስየ ‘and my soul will be’, with the third-person feminine verb agreeing with ነፍስ ‘soul’ (feminine). ምስለ ነፍሰ ዳዊት ‘with the soul of David’ (ነፍሰ construct). ወይመጽእ መድኅን ወያወፅአነ እምሲኦል ‘and the saviour will come and bring us out of Sheol’: ያወፅአነ = ያወፅእ ‘he brings out’ (causative of ወፅአ) + -ነ ‘us’, the harrowing of Hell; the Geʿez expects Christ to bring the righteous dead out. ቀደምት ወደኀርት ‘former and later’, plural adjectives qualifying ወአዝማድየ ‘my kin’ (ዘመድ ‘kin’, plural አዝማድ + -የ) (?). ወለደቂቅየኒ = ወ- + ለ- + ደቂቅየ ‘my sons’ + -ኒ ‘also’. ፫ here is the spoken ሠለስቱ ‘three’ before መላእክት ‘angels’ (the three of the angels, Gabriel, Michael, Uriel). ኀያላን ‘mighty ones’, እለ የዐቅብዎሙ ‘who guard them’ (የዐቅብ ‘he guards’, ዐቀበ; 3mp imperfect + -ሆሙ).

sentences.t: ረከብኩ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወረከብኩ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ምድር ።
sentences.l: I-found kingdom-of heavens, and-I-found kingdom-of earth.
sentences.i: I have found the kingdom of heaven, and I have found the kingdom of the earth.
sentences.n: ረከብኩ ‘I found’ (1cs perfect of ረከበ), with the accusative construct መንግሥተ ‘kingdom of’, ሰማያት ‘heavens’ (plural) and ምድር ‘earth’. The perfect is that of a settled certainty, ‘I have found (and so have)’; I translate it as the English perfect. ‘Kingdom of heaven’ is the Gospel phrase (Matthew 3:2 and elsewhere).

sentences.t: መኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ መሓሪ ፡ ዘይምሕር ፡ ወይምሕክ ፡ ተግባሮ ፡ ዘይሰሪ ፡ አበሳ ፡ ለመአብሳን ፡ ወኢያጠፍእ ፡ ዝክረ ፡ ነሳሕያን ፤
sentences.l: Who like God, merciful, who he-has-mercy and-he-spares (?) his-work, who he-forgives sin for-wrongdoers and-not-he-blots-out memory-of penitents;
sentences.i: Who is like God, the merciful, who has mercy and spares his handiwork (?), who forgives the sin of wrongdoers and does not blot out the memory of the penitent;
sentences.n: መኑ ከመ እግዚኣብሔር ‘who is like God?’ echoes Micah 7:18 (‘who is a God like you, pardoning iniquity?’; compare Exodus 15:11). መሓሪ ‘merciful’ is the agent noun of ምሕረ ‘have mercy’; ዘይምሕር ‘who has mercy’ (3ms imperfect). ወይምሕክ ተግባሮ is uncertain (?): the verb looks like ምሕከ, which I take as a variant of ‘spare’ from the context, and ተግባሮ is ተግባር ‘work, deed’ + -ሁ ‘his’, which I read as the work of his hands, his creatures (?). ዘይሰሪ ‘who forgives’ (ሰረየ ‘forgive’), አበሳ ‘sin’ with ለመአብሳን ‘to the wrongdoers’ (ለ- here marking the one who sins; ‘the sin of the sinners’ is also possible). ኢያጠፍእ is the 3ms negated subjunctive/imperfect of አጠፍአ ‘extinguish, blot out’; ዝክረ ‘memory of’ (construct), ነሳሕያን ‘penitents’ (plural of ነሳሒ).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኵለንታሁ ፡ ስርየት ፡ ወኵለንታሁ ፡ ምሕረት ፡ ወሎቱ ፡ ይደሉ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ አሜን ፨ ፨
sentences.l: for all-of-him forgiveness and-all-of-him mercy, and-to-him is-fitting praise, Amen. ፨ ፨
sentences.i: for he is wholly forgiveness and wholly mercy, and to him praise is due. Amen.
sentences.n: ኵለንታሁ = ኵለንታ ‘the whole of’ + -ሁ ‘him’, ‘all of him’, so ‘he is altogether forgiveness’. ወሎቱ ይደሉ ስብሐት ‘and to him is due praise’: ሎቱ is ለ + -ቱ ‘him’, ይደሉ is 3ms imperfect of ደለወ ‘be fitting, due’, ስብሐት ‘praise, glory’. The double ፨ ፨ closes the part and the chapter.
